description: Gate 1 open (basket 1 fired, slide 1 shut) and 3 free size-1 slimes (A, B, C) starting down the cave's route back, on the tunnel's first shelf below the pocket, made of the pocket's sleepers; the camera is away, on the start basin. Off screen they follow the route back at the deterministic pace, are left alone after 10 s and rejoin the train well before they are lost. For off-screen simulation (chunk 15).
